suite_type_note: Fragment-style suite = CONTROL type (owner, 2026-10-31): minimal use; the primary experimental mass is active development + review run as live testing.
provider_phrases_note: Mandatory provider phrases (harmony_hub/workspace/prompts/prompt_engine.py PREFIXES/SUFFIXES + config/prompts/profiles/*.json) are composed into the dispatched prompt and hashed when a campaign declares them per model route. None are established for lab-1's two OpenRouter routes (the established sets are DeepSeek-shaped); absent = NOT ESTABLISHED, never silently skipped where a set exists.

design.type: full factorial (2x2x2), generated by deepcli.observatory.doe.full_factorial via scripts/doe/lab_runner.py
design.unit_of_observation: one executed run (one task under one cell) = one EXPERIMENT record
design.replication: 8 tasks x 8 cells = 64 runs, one observation per cell per task

settings_fixed.context: explicit full target document (pilot-1 winning representation); routing fixed icm-guided

hypothesis.statement: For source-grounded fragment recovery, the strict-verbatim prompt (prompt-a) beats the loose prompt (prompt-b) across models and roles; model and role effects are smaller than the prompt effect, and no prompt x model interaction reverses the prompt ranking.
hypothesis.predeclared_threshold: selection requires top cell mean accuracy >= 0.80 and margin >= 0.05 over the runner-up cell

outcomes.primary: source-grounded task accuracy = required fragments recovered / required fragments (same scorer definition as pilot-1)

required_fragments: never counts as the presenting surface's results
does not replace the deterministic scorer
One dispatched workflow run = one observation
Do not use latency as a correctness proxy

suite_provenance: Task suite inherited verbatim from pilot-1 (experiments/doe/pilot-1-context-routing-x-compression/DESIGN.json) so lab-1 results are comparable to the pilot-1 offline baseline.
execution_environment: LIVE dispatch via fleet provider lanes, OpenRouter free routes only (model-selection-market free-only rule). Each run = one configured instance (treatment.instance stamped by the runner plan). Execution is dispatched separately; this record + PLAN.json consume zero quota.
constraints: verdict only vs the pre-registered selection rule
quota_note: 64 planned runs on free OpenRouter routes; zero paid quota. Plan generation is offline-deterministic.
